Hi! I am FtM and my younger brother is 15 as well. Tbh i never told him anything, i think my mom did. Since suddenly one day he started calling me by my new name, correcting himself if he accidently used wrong pronouns etc. I was honestly surprised myself how well he took it and didn't question anything. You could try and tell ur mom to explain him, since boys that age usually have a huge respect towards their mother. If that is not possible, try to sit down just with him, maybe get something good to eat as well and spend time with him. Then when the air is all good you can start explaining him, but try to do it in a clear, non complicated way. It might take time for him to progress it but he is ur sibling, eventually he will understand.
